description: Read what AI crawlers and AI referrals actually did on a site in the last 7, 28 or 30 days: hits by agent, previous-window delta, markdown negotiation, machine-file reads, AI referral hosts, and robots violations. Use this when the user asks whether AI bots visit, whether they are blocked, or whether AI sends traffic. Returns na with a reason when the site has no probe data; missing data is never treated as zero. Read-only. Requires the audit:read scope.
name: get_ai_traffic
title: AI crawler and referral activity
